app.name: SoundPush
app.startingHint: If this takes long, check for a macOS permission or Keychain prompt.
app.failedHint: Quit SoundPush from the tray icon and open it again. If it keeps happening, the log says why.
home.title: What do you want to do?
home.empty.title: Pair your phone to get started
home.empty.body: Scan a code with the SoundPush app on your phone. It takes a few seconds.
home.noConnected: No paired device is connected right now.
home.noCapable: None of the connected devices can do this.
task.sendSystemAudio.desc: Play this computer's sound on your phone
task.receiveMicToVirtualMic.desc: Other apps can use your phone as their microphone
task.receiveMicToVirtualMic.descNamed: In other apps, choose “{0}” as the microphone
task.headset.desc: Listen and talk through your phone
task.receiveAppAudio.desc: Play your phone's apps on this computer
task.unavailable.loopback: Not available on this computer yet
task.unavailable.virtualMic: Set up the virtual microphone in Audio
home.alreadyActive: Already streaming to {0}. Use Stop above to end it.
devices.title: Devices
devices.nearbyNone: No other SoundPush devices found on this network.
devices.forget.confirm: Forget {0}? It will need to pair again.
perm.sendAudioToMe: Can send audio to this computer
pair.title: Pair a device
pair.scan: Open SoundPush on your phone and scan this code.
pair.addressHint: Shown on the other device under Settings → About
pair.codeBody: Make sure the same code is shown on both devices.
request.title: {0} wants to use your microphone
request.titleAudio: {0} wants to listen to this computer
audio.title: Audio
audio.apps.desc: Send one app's sound, or everything except one app.
audio.muteLocal: Mute this computer's speakers while sending
audio.highPass.desc: Removes rumble, desk bumps and wind noise below 80 Hz.
audio.noiseSuppression.desc: Reduces keyboard, fan and background noise. Uses more CPU.
audio.micDenied: Microphone access is turned off for SoundPush in the system privacy settings.
audio.micAsk: SoundPush needs your permission to use this computer's microphone.
audio.bluetoothHint: This output is Bluetooth, which adds about 150–250 ms of delay and can cut out. The Stable latency setting avoids dropouts; wired speakers or headphones have less delay.
audio.virtualMic.desc: Apps like Discord, Zoom and OBS use this as a microphone.
audio.virtualMic.help: The virtual cable your phone's microphone is sent into. Automatic picks the one installed.
audio.virtualMic.ready: Ready. In Google Meet, Zoom, Discord or a recorder app, choose “{0}” as the microphone.
audio.virtualMic.missing: No virtual cable found. Install the free {0}, restart the computer if asked, then check again.
audio.virtualMic.notCable: “{0}” is a speaker, not a virtual cable, so SoundPush doesn't use it. It would play your voice out loud and other apps couldn't hear it.
audio.virtualMic.sp.hint: Install SoundPush Microphone once. macOS asks for your password; nothing else needs to be installed.
audio.virtualMic.sp.pending: SoundPush Microphone is installed but not active yet. Check again, or restart the Mac.
audio.virtualMic.linux.hint: Install SoundPush Microphone once. SoundPush adds it to your sound system (PipeWire or PulseAudio); no password or driver is needed.
audio.virtualMic.linux.pending: SoundPush Microphone isn't active. Make sure PipeWire or PulseAudio is running, then install it again.
audio.virtualMic.vb.hint: Install VB-CABLE, the free virtual microphone by VB-Audio. SoundPush downloads the official package and opens its setup: click “Install Driver”, then restart Windows.
audio.virtualMic.vb.installed: VB-CABLE is installed. Restart Windows to finish.
audio.virtualMic.vb.pending: VB-CABLE is installed. Restart Windows to finish the setup.
audio.virtualMic.vbCredit: VB-CABLE by VB-Audio. VB-CABLE is a donationware, all participations are welcome.
audio.virtualMic.installFailed: Couldn't finish the virtual microphone setup: {0}
audio.virtualMic.restartBody: Windows restarts in 10 seconds to finish installing VB-CABLE. Save your work in other apps first. SoundPush opens again after the restart.
audio.virtualMic.autoStart: Start phone microphone when an app uses it
audio.virtualMic.autoStart.desc: When Zoom, Discord or another app opens the virtual microphone, SoundPush starts your phone's microphone, and stops it again when the app is done.
latency.lowLatency.desc: Games and video. Needs a strong connection.
latency.stable.desc: Music and weak Wi-Fi. Fewer dropouts.
audio.hotkeys.desc: Work in every app, even when SoundPush is in the background.
audio.muteHotkey.desc: Press to mute or unmute the microphone.
audio.pushToTalkHotkey.desc: The microphone is on only while you hold these keys.
settings.title: Settings
settings.launchAtLogin.disabledByOs: Turned off in the system's startup apps, so SoundPush won't start. Turn it back on there.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running when the window is closed
settings.keepWindowInMemory: Keep the window in memory for instant reopen
settings.keepWindowInMemory.desc: Closing the window normally frees the memory it used, and reopening takes a moment. Keep it loaded to reopen instantly.
settings.preventSleep: Keep the computer awake while streaming
settings.defaultDevices: Make SoundPush the default input and output while active
settings.defaultDevices.desc: While your phone is in use as a microphone or speaker, apps pick it up without being set up one by one. Your usual devices come back when the stream stops.
settings.audioCues: Play a sound on connect and disconnect
settings.audioCues.desc: Short, quiet tones when a device connects or disconnects, a stream starts or stops, or the microphone is muted.
settings.privacyNote: Audio never leaves your devices. SoundPush has no accounts, ads or tracking.
settings.auditLog.desc: Pairing, permission and stream events on this computer. Kept for 30 days and never sent anywhere.
audit.title: Security log
audit.desc: What happened on this computer: pairing, permission changes, streams and refused connections. Entries are kept for 30 days and never leave this computer.
audit.clear.confirm: Delete all entries? A note that the log was cleared stays.
audit.pairingRejected.proof: Refused pairing with {0}: wrong or expired code
audit.pairingRejected.closed: Refused pairing with {0}: pairing wasn't open
error.security.pairingRateLimited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
notice.pairingRateLimited: Too many pairing attempts from {0}. Pairing from there is paused for a minute.
settings.debugLogging.desc: Adds detail to the log to help find a problem. Turns itself off after 24 hours.
settings.advanced.desc: SoundPush decides all of this by itself. Change something here only if support asked you to; it is explained in the Advanced settings guide.
settings.continuousCapture.desc: Keep sending while nothing is playing instead of pausing during silence. Uses more bandwidth; helps drivers that stall when a stream goes quiet.
settings.keepAudioDevicesOpen.desc: Audio devices normally close a minute after the last stream. Keep them open for devices that are slow or unreliable to reopen.
settings.realtimeAudioPriority.desc: Asks the system to run capture and playback ahead of other work, so a busy computer doesn't cause dropouts. Turn it off only if a virtual audio driver misbehaves.
settings.credits.body: Built with Rust, Tauri, Svelte, Opus and RNNoise. Icons by Lucide. Translated by volunteers.
diag.title: Export diagnostics
diag.body: SoundPush saves a text file on this computer that you can attach to a problem report. Nothing is uploaded.
diag.showAll: Show everything that will be saved
trouble.micApps: Microphone doesn't show up in apps
trouble.check.noNetwork: This computer isn't connected to a network.
trouble.check.firewallBlocked: Windows Firewall blocks other devices from connecting to SoundPush.
trouble.check.firewallBlockedPublic: Windows Firewall blocks other devices, and “{0}” is set up as a public network — Windows keeps devices there from reaching this computer.
trouble.check.firewallOk: The firewall lets devices connect to SoundPush.
trouble.check.publicNetwork: “{0}” is set up as a public network. If it's your home or work network, mark it as private so devices can find each other.
trouble.check.hidden: “Who can find this computer” is set to Nobody.
trouble.check.notConnected: No paired device is connected. Open SoundPush on your phone and make sure both devices use the same Wi-Fi.
trouble.check.guestNetwork: Guest and public Wi-Fi often block devices from seeing each other. Use your phone's hotspot or a USB cable instead.
trouble.check.isolated: This network blocks devices from talking to each other. Your phone is on it and SoundPush knows where it is, but nothing gets through — guest and hotel Wi-Fi usually work this way. Use your phone's hotspot or a USB cable instead.
trouble.check.vpn: {0} is carrying this computer's whole connection, which usually blocks the local network too. Turn on “Allow LAN traffic” in its settings, or disconnect it while you stream.
trouble.check.audioEnhancements: {0} is running. Audio enhancement software of this kind sits in the sound path and can make recordings silent. If sound is missing, close it or turn its effects off and try again.
trouble.check.weakSignal: The connection to {0} is weak. Move closer to the router or use 5 GHz Wi-Fi.
trouble.check.useStable: The Stable latency setting rides out a weak connection with fewer dropouts.
trouble.check.sleep: The computer may go to sleep and end the stream. Keep it awake while streaming.
trouble.check.connectionOk: No connection problems found right now.
trouble.check.noStream: Nothing is streaming right now. Start a task on the Home page.
trouble.check.noOutputDevice: This computer has no playback device.
trouble.check.deviceMissing: “{0}” is selected under Audio but isn't connected.
trouble.check.systemAudioDenied: macOS doesn't allow SoundPush to record this computer's sound. Turn on SoundPush under Screen & System Audio Recording.
trouble.check.mediaFeaturePack: Windows media components are missing. Install the Media Feature Pack under Optional features.
trouble.check.appOnly: Only {0} is being sent. Other apps aren't heard.
trouble.check.bluetooth: “{0}” is a Bluetooth device, which adds about 150–250 ms of delay and can cut out.
trouble.check.audioOk: No sound problems found right now.
trouble.check.virtualMicMissing: The virtual microphone isn't set up yet.
trouble.check.virtualMicRestart: The virtual microphone is installed but not active yet. Restart the computer.
trouble.check.virtualMicIgnored: “{0}” is selected as the virtual microphone, but SoundPush can't use it.
trouble.check.chooseInput: In your app's audio settings, choose “{0}” as the microphone.
trouble.check.micMuted: The microphone is muted in SoundPush.
trouble.check.micDenied: Microphone access is turned off in the privacy settings, so apps can't record the virtual microphone.
trouble.check.startMic: Start “Use phone as microphone” on the Home page, or turn on automatic start under Audio.
trouble.check.dropouts: The stream has had many dropouts.
trouble.check.noiseSuppression: Noise suppression uses extra CPU. Turn it off if the computer is busy.
trouble.check.closer: Walls and distance weaken Wi-Fi. A 5 GHz network or USB gives the steadiest sound.
firewall.title: Let devices connect to SoundPush
firewall.body: Windows Firewall is stopping your phone from connecting. SoundPush can add a rule that lets only SoundPush receive connections, and nothing else.
firewall.publicNetwork: Windows has “{0}” set up as a public network, and keeps devices on public networks from reaching this computer. The rule on its own will not be enough here.
firewall.makePrivateNote: Choose this only for your own home or work network. Windows then lets the devices on it find each other.
firewall.cannotMakePrivate: SoundPush can't change this network's type here — a company policy may be in control.
firewall.pickOne: Pick one, or your phone still won’t reach this computer on “{0}”.
firewall.includePublic: Allow SoundPush on public networks too
firewall.includePublicNote: Only SoundPush is opened, but it stays open on cafés’ and hotels’ networks as well.
firewall.includePublicAhead: Also allow on public networks (cafés, hotels). Not recommended.
firewall.adminNote: Windows asks for administrator permission once. SoundPush itself keeps running without it.
firewall.fixed: Devices can connect to SoundPush now.
firewall.stillBlocked: The firewall still blocks SoundPush. Another firewall app or a company policy may be in control.
firewall.stillPublic: The rule is in place, but Windows still has this network set to public. Mark it as private, or allow public networks too.
banner.firewall: Windows Firewall blocks other devices from connecting to this computer.
banner.systemAudioDenied: macOS doesn't allow SoundPush to record this computer's sound, so other devices would hear silence.
banner.mediaFeaturePack: Windows media components are missing ({0}). If audio doesn't work, install the Media Feature Pack under Optional features.
onboarding.welcome.body: Use your phone as a speaker, microphone or headset for this computer.
onboarding.name: Name this computer
onboarding.launchAtLogin.desc: Your phone can connect whenever the computer is on. SoundPush waits quietly in the background.
onboarding.getApp: No SoundPush on your phone yet? Scan this code to download the Android app.
closeHint.title: SoundPush keeps running
closeHint.body: Closing the window leaves SoundPush running in the tray, so your devices can still connect and streams keep playing. Open it again or quit from the tray icon.
closeHint.bodyMac: Closing the window leaves SoundPush running in the menu bar, so your devices can still connect and streams keep playing. Open it again or quit from the menu bar icon.
closeHint.noTray: This desktop doesn't show tray icons, so SoundPush stays in the taskbar as a minimized window while it runs. Quit SoundPush to stop it completely.
notice.trustStoreRecovered: Paired devices were reset because the stored list was damaged.
notice.identityReset: This computer's identity was reset because its stored key was damaged. Pair your devices again.
notice.peerForgotUs: {0} no longer recognises this computer. Pair again to reconnect.
notice.settingsRecovered: Settings were reset because the settings file was damaged.
notice.muteSpeakersUnsupported: This device can't mute its speakers remotely.
notice.unstableConnection: The connection to {0} keeps dropping, so its streams use the Stable latency setting for now. A stronger Wi-Fi signal or USB helps.
notice.autoMicStarted: An app is using the virtual microphone, so {0}'s microphone was started.
error.network.unreachable: Couldn't reach the device. Check that it's on and on the same network.
error.network.blocked: This network blocks devices from talking to each other.
error.network.firewall: The firewall blocks devices from connecting to this computer.
error.hotkey.invalid: That key combination can't be used.
error.hotkey.duplicate: The other SoundPush shortcut already uses these keys.
error.hotkey.unavailable: Another app already uses these keys. Choose a different combination.
error.security.pairingExpired: The pairing code expired. Show a new code.
error.compat.version: The other device needs a SoundPush update.
error.permission.mic: Microphone access is turned off for SoundPush.
error.audio.loopbackUnsupported: Sending this computer's audio isn't supported on this system yet.
error.audio.virtualMicMissing: The virtual microphone isn't set up.
error.engine.starting: SoundPush is still starting. Try again in a moment.
nav.label: Main
chart.summary: Last 5 minutes: latency {0} to {2} ms, average {1} ms; packet loss up to {3} %
banner.tethering: This computer's internet goes through your phone's USB tethering, which uses mobile data. A USB cable with USB debugging (adb) connects SoundPush without it.
settings.shortcuts: Shortcuts: {0}+1 to {0}+4 switch pages. {0}+plus and {0}+minus change the text size.
update.auto.desc: Looks for a new version on GitHub once a day. Nothing is installed without asking you.
update.channel.desc: Beta gets new versions earlier. They may have more bugs. You can switch back at any time.
update.ready: SoundPush {0} is ready. Restart to finish updating.
update.checkFailed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
update.downloadFailed: Couldn't download the update. Try again, or download it from the website.
update.installFailed: Couldn't install the update. Download the new version from the website instead.
devices.profile.desc: Overrides Audio settings for this device. Latency applies to sound you receive from it; quality applies to streams you start.
devices.usb.desc: For Android phones connected by cable with USB debugging turned on. Works without Wi-Fi.
devices.usb.noAdb: adb wasn't found. Install Android platform-tools, or add adb to PATH.
devices.usb.noDevice: No phone found. Connect it by USB and turn on USB debugging.
devices.usb.unauthorized: Allow USB debugging on {0}, then check again.
devices.usb.connected: USB is set up for {0}. The phone connects within a few seconds.
devices.usb.unavailable: USB connections aren't available because the port is in use.
nettest.title: Network test
nettest.desc: Measures delay, jitter, packet loss and speed to this device. Takes about 10 seconds.
nettest.tip.good: This connection is good for streaming.
nettest.tip.loss: Packets are being lost. Move closer to the router, use 5 GHz Wi-Fi, or connect by USB.
nettest.tip.jitter: The delay varies a lot. Other traffic on the network may be interfering.
nettest.tip.latency: The delay is high. Check that both devices are on the same network.
nettest.tip.bandwidth: The connection is slow. A lower bitrate avoids dropouts.
notice.crashReport: SoundPush closed unexpectedly. A crash report was saved on this computer; it's included when you export diagnostics.
